verdict: Paid ads remain off; organic is holding but next steps need a decision.
narrative: Paid advertising has been inactive for the full 28-day window — no spend on Meta or Google, and no leads from either channel. Your organic presence is carrying all the weight: your Google Business Profile generated 157 actions this period (54 calls, 103 website clicks), and search traffic held steady with 657 clicks and over 50,000 impressions. A sharp drop in Google Business Profile activity in the final days of the week — down roughly 97% versus the prior seven days — is being investigated now as a local visibility issue. Reactivating paid ads and resolving the contact-rate bottleneck both depend on the extension agreement being signed; once that is in place, the next 90-day scope can move forward immediately.
